2607.19845.title: Sentence Splitter: Uncovering Latent Factual Structure for Self-Supervised Learning
2607.19845.paper_summary: This paper introduces Sentence Splitter, a self-supervised framework built upon a T5-based encoder--decoder architecture for uncovering the latent factual structure of natural language sentences. The proposed method identifies the semantic boundary between a descriptive prefix (head) and its factual completion (tail) by formulating sentence splitting as a discrete segmentation problem, where a sentence of length $N$ admits $N$ possible split points but only one recovers the intended head--tail structure. Rather than explicitly searching over all candidate boundaries, the model learns to recover the factual completion through probabilistic sequence generation. To eliminate the need for manual annotation, symbolic head--tail pairs are first verbalized into natural-language templates that provide supervision for training the Sentence Splitter. The trained splitter is then applied to raw text to extract aligned prefix--tail pairs, which are subsequently used to train a generative model that proposes additional plausible completions through a lightweight bootstrapping process. This unified pipeline provides a scalable and structure-aware approach to constructing self-supervised training data while bridging symbolic knowledge and natural language. Experiments on both structured and naturally occurring text demonstrate that the proposed splitter generalizes beyond synthetic templates and that the resulting structure-aware supervision consistently improves downstream performance on knowledge graph completion and commonsense question answering, highlighting the effectiveness of recovering latent factual structure for knowledge-centric NLP.
2607.19845.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文介紹了句子分割器（Sentence Splitter），這是一個基於 T5 編碼器-解碼器架構的自我監督框架，旨在揭示自然語言句子的潛在事實結構。所提出的方法通過將句子分割公式化為離散分割問題來識別描述性前綴（頭）和其事實完成（尾）之間的語義邊界，其中長度為 $N$ 的句子允許 $N$ 個可能的分割點，但只有一個能夠恢復預期的頭-尾結構。模型不是明確地搜索所有候選邊界，而是學會通過概率序列生成來恢復事實完成。為了消除手動標註的需求，符號頭-尾對首先被轉化為自然語言模板，這些模板為訓練句子分割器提供監督。訓練好的分割器隨後應用於原始文本，以提取對齊的前綴-尾對，這些對隨後用於訓練一個生成模型，該模型通過輕量級的自舉過程提出額外的合理完成。這個統一的流程提供了一種可擴展且結構感知的方法來構建自我監督的訓練數據，同時橋接符號知識和自然語言。在結構化和自然發生的文本上的實驗表明，所提出的分割器超越了合成模板的泛化能力，且所產生的結構感知監督持續改善知識圖譜完成和常識問答的下游性能，突顯了恢復潛在事實結構在以知識為中心的自然語言處理中的有效性。
